questions.question: What is a deoptimisation in V8?
options: Discarding optimised machine code and falling back to a lower tier when a speculation about types fails
Deleting unused variables during garbage collection
Turning off the JIT for the whole process
questions.explanation: Optimising tiers speculate using type feedback; when an assumption breaks (for example a string where numbers were seen), V8 deoptimises.

questions.question: Why can delete obj.key on a hot object hurt performance?
options: It triggers a full garbage collection
It can push the object into slow dictionary mode, losing its fast hidden-class layout
It converts the object into an array
questions.explanation: Deleting properties can turn an object into dictionary mode; setting the field to undefined or building a new object keeps fast properties.

questions.question: An inline cache at a property-access site has seen many different object shapes. What is it called?
questions.explanation: One shape is monomorphic, a few is polymorphic, and many shapes is megamorphic, which falls back to slow generic lookups.

questions.question: Which garbage-collection event is most likely to show up as p99 latency spikes?
questions.explanation: Scavenges are short; long Mark-Compact pauses in the old generation stop JavaScript longer and appear as tail-latency spikes.
